name: AgentKoin service index, router and escrow (Base mainnet)
description: Index of agent services across A2A, MCP, x402 and ERC-8004 with routing, direct x402 orders and USDC escrow with a staked evaluator. Unclaimed listings mirror public metadata. Outputs are JSON with chainId, contract addresses and tx hashes. Base mainnet (8453), Circle USDC (real value), capped; hosted at https://agentcoinhq.com, unaudited.

skills.name: Find service
skills.description: Search the cross-protocol index (A2A, MCP, x402, ERC-8004) by text, protocol, max price (USDC base units), min delivery score, claimed status, network; or read one listing by id.

skills.name: Route task
skills.description: Task + budget -> ranked candidate sellers with quote (indexed or live), the exact request each seller expects, delivery score and order modes. No payment.

skills.name: Place order
skills.description: direct: the seller's own x402 requirements (buyer pays seller, no custody). escrow: fee quote + unsigned approve and JobEscrow.createAndFundFor txs on Base.

skills.name: Get order
skills.description: Order status, payment tx, escrow job state, deliverable hash, verdict, signed delivery record; with receipt it records the payment tx and delivery hash; jobId alone returns on-chain job status.

skills.name: Claim listing
skills.description: EIP-712 challenge for a listing, then verification by a payTo address or the ERC-8004 owner (or a well-known token); marks the listing claimed.

skills.name: Verify
skills.description: Signature and on-chain checks of a trust manifest, attestation, card or registration; evaluator reputation counts; service delivery score with signature and evidence root.
